_comment: Central baseline for playbook validation. Holds the shared platform versions per device CATEGORY (reference=halo_box, apu=halo/stx/krk, gpu=dGPUs), plus the default validated date. Per-playbook app versions (ComfyUI, etc.) live in each playbook.json under 'validatedVersions' and override matching baseline rows by key name. At request time: versions for a device+OS = baseline.<category>[os] + playbook.validatedVersions.<category>[os]. Empty string hides a row (fill-me-in reminder).
